name: Cosmocracy
summary: Party debate game where candidates invent facts about sci-fi issues to pander to alien races for votes.
rules_text: Each player picks an alien Race with Likes. Candidate cards matching races are shuffled. Each debate, draw two Candidates and choose a non-debating Moderator. Moderator draws an Issue card, adding a Matter card or a Race if required, then reads the issue. First Candidate chooses Pro or Con; the other takes opposite. First Candidate gets 30 seconds to argue, inventing facts about the universe which become canon and cannot be contradicted except by adding spin, then second Candidate gets 30 second rebuttal. Voters may ask one follow-up each, debaters may answer once. All non-debating players including Moderator vote secretly by orienting their Race card Pro/Con, then reveal simultaneously. Each vote gives winner a token face-down. Play continues until all Candidates have debated once per round. Play 4 rounds for 3-7 players, 3 rounds for 8 players. Most tokens wins; ties broken by extra majority debates.
rating_reason: Party voting/arguing game, playable with talk and votes, bluffing/pandering fits engine
